findings.body: The command test always supplies an existing OPEN pull request here, so it never exercises `forge close` when `_pull_request` returns none and `_publish` creates a pull request (src/forge/close.py:231-244) before the new attachment call at src/forge/close.py:109. A regression that skips attachment only for newly opened pull requests would pass this test. Add a `forge close` case that creates the PR and asserts the attachment request and its pinned fields.
findings.title: Not done: newly opened pull request attachment test
